title: Retire retained revision-form execution_observe envelopes locally, like verification_record and evaluate already do
outcome: TermAl never resends a retained execution observation whose source identity is revision-only (content-v1, git-commit or other legacy source_revision); it settles it locally as retired before any send, and the production acceptance of revision-only identities for new sends is removed.
acceptance: A behavioural test shows a retained execution observation whose source basis is revision-only (no source_id) is settled locally as retired before any send, with a visible diagnostic and no Engram call, while a SourceId observation is still delivered.

Production code no longer accepts a revision-only identity for any new outbound observation, baseline or naming request; stored historical values remain readable as stored, and existing delivery tests for SourceId observations stay green.
